attributes.name: Staff of Toxins
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6+2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d12 and the Poison trait.

Display this card when a character at your location encounters a monster. While displayed, add 1d6 and the Poison trait to checks to defeat monsters by characters at your location. At the end of each turn, discard a spell or this card.
